name: Duck

revision.note: Rewritten from the human-performer reading to a photoreal CGI animal.

rendering.rule: bible/cultivation.json SUP-002 (amended BIB-0027); member of FAC-caucus-race-company (no uniform)
rendering.limits: Duck anatomy throughout; speech by bill movement. No clothing, no cartoon face.

gender_note.reason: The source calls the Duck 'it'. His one intervention is a pedantic question about what the Archbishop 'found' (ch003); male is kept, and the drake plumage now carries it.

base_age_note.reason: Persona age (young-middle-aged, earnest), kept for voice casting. As an animal: an adult drake in full breeding plumage.

hair.color: glossy bottle-green head, thin white neck ring, chestnut-brown breast, grey-brown flanks, black tail with one upcurled drake's curl, blue-violet wing speculum
hair.style: sleek and waterproof; beads of water roll off (the only party member not draggled)
hair.reason: Species plumage; the old card's green-cravat / white-collar cues were taken from these same markings.

eyes.expression: earnest, blinking, literal-minded; head tilted to one side to ask

face.shape: rounded green head, broad flat bill

build.height_note: Standing height; body length 55-60 cm, species-true.
build.posture: waddles with feet turned out; swims easily in the pool
build.scale_reference: Shares the pool and the bank with the shrunken Alice (SUP-003); a little shorter than the Dodo.

entry_state.state: on the bank with the party; wet but sleek
entry_state.quote: all dripping wet, cross, and uncomfortable
entry_state.reason: Sourced wet state; a duck's waterproof plumage keeps him sleek, which sets him apart in the circle.

marks.description: the upcurled black drake's curl at the tail
marks.reason: Species identifier readable in a wide shot.

default_outfit_tone.summary: none: he wears nothing; his look is the mallard drake plumage
default_outfit_tone.reason: The text gives the Duck no clothing; per SUP-002 (BIB-0027) the old morning coat and webbed gloves are dropped.

prompt_base_en: photoreal mallard drake, glossy bottle-green head, thin white neck ring, chestnut breast, grey-brown flanks, upcurled black tail curl, yellow-olive bill, orange webbed feet, water beading on sleek feathers, standing on a muddy pool bank with its head tilted inquisitively, natural bird anatomy, live-action film plate
